title: Opposition rally against President Ouattara’s third-term bid, Abidjan stadium
location: stadium, Abidjan; exact venue name not resolved in retained pages
organizer: opposition parties / coalition (exact organizing body unresolved)
participants_original: Al Jazeera estimates about 20,000 by early afternoon; Euronews reports about 30,000. These are separate source estimates for the same rally, not additive.
threshold_50_evidence: Both opened reports describe a stadium rally and give estimates in the tens of thousands, comfortably above 50; figures remain source-specific.

occurrence_and_date.value: Both pages describe opposition rally in Abidjan on 10 October 2020.

attendance.value: Al Jazeera ~20,000 by early afternoon; Euronews ~30,000; distinct estimates, not summed.

demand.value: Opposition rally against incumbent’s third-term bid; Euronews reports requests concerning the constitutional council and electoral commission.

state_response.value: No action by state directed at this rally verified; broader violence in surrounding weeks is not attributed to it.

title: INFAS health-training students demonstrate over scholarship arrears and LMD implementation, Bouaké
location: outside CHU de Bouaké / INFAS Bouaké; KOACI also mentions classmates in Daloa and other towns, without distinct dates or counts
organizer: INFAS students, organizer not further identified
threshold_50_evidence: No attendee count in opened KOACI body; threshold unresolved. Other towns are not aggregated.

occurrence_and_date.value: KOACI reports student manifestations beginning in Bouaké on 13 October; other towns not separable.

demand.value: Ten months scholarship arrears, internship stipend, LMD qualification system.

state_response.value: Tear gas dispersion and more than ten student detentions reported; attribution beyond KOACI uncorroborated.
